title: 第26章 大队长敷衍了事
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 赵小义听见声音，手里的柴刀，扬在半空停顿了几秒，最后还是轻轻放了下来。算了，今天他是来给张家一个下马威，犯不着跟刘烨这个傻大个冲突。但他今天可是‘师出有名’的，于是转身朝围观的人群说道，“徐喜弟这个贱丫头，她害我爹被公安抓起来了，张家必须给我一个说法。”“再骂一句试试？你爹不干人事，公安抓他有什么不对？”刘烨把肩上的踩犁和钉锄放在一边，徒手走进院里。这件事，刘烨昨晚收工回来，就听人议论了。是赵丁活该。“大队长很快就过来，你要说法跟他要。侮辱了人家闺女，别说你爹，要是让我知道你也有份，我也送你去见公安！”“也就是遇到刘宇宁那样的读书人，换我，直接给他三条腿全废掉！”看到刘烨靠近，赵小义也不敢在院里待，强装镇定走下来，站到人群前面。刘烨这个大块头，一个拳头能把他脑袋拍进肚子里去！“你可别冤枉我，我……我才没有……”赵小义明显说话有些磕巴。啧啧啧！人群中，有人小声咂舌。这不是明显做贼心虚吗？赵丁父子，可真不是人！畜生！咂舌之后，他们看张家，又多了几分鄙夷。都让人欺负成这样了，这会儿关着门在里面当缩头乌龟，换谁家，非得冲出来拼命不可。被打死打残不可怕，让人瞧不起，骑在脖子上拉屎可绝对不行。俗话怎么说？士可杀不可辱……看来昨天还是高看徐喜弟那个小媳妇了，靠一个妇女，怎么让这一家子怂包立得起来？“赵小义，你不会真有份吧？”刘烨眼神一眯，三两步就冲过来，提起赵小义的领口。“你你你，你有证据吗？”赵小义没想到刘烨说动手就动手，一时也慌了神。“哼，我要是有证据，你的狗叼现在就掉地上了。”刘烨松开了手。没办法，就是明知道这人心里有鬼，但没有证据，现在打人又犯法。“赵小义，这些都是你干的？”大队长姗姗来迟，看到满院狼藉，眉头紧锁。听到外边有刘烨和大队长的声音，张家的门总算开了。范金花和徐喜弟从堂屋里出来，巴儿姐已经吃上第四个烤糍粑。这次不小心，烤到一半，鼓起来的糍粑让火苗给点着了，焦黑一片。吃得满嘴黑。一看就是没心没肺的样。“大队长，你看，我们家院子，篱笆墙，还有菜地，全让赵小义砍了，这事该怎么办吧。”范金花心疼地看着满院狼藉的菜地，后院连根蒜苗都不剩。大队长也头疼，指着赵小义，“现在是新社会，不是你想干什么就能干什么的。把人院子砍成这样，你是自己来修好呢，还是掏钱赔偿？”“还有，你爹干的那些是违法犯罪，天理不容，坐牢都算轻的。在旧社会还要枪毙！你今天干的这些……”也是违法犯罪。可大队长不想闹大，想息事宁人。可徐喜弟不同意，“赵小义今天扛刀上门，也是违法犯罪，要修要赔，见了公安再说！”又送公安？人群吸了一口冷气，这是要把赵家父子都送去坐牢？“见公安？”赵小义一听徐喜弟的话，就怒了。“大队长你评评理！他们家，前脚跟我爹要了五十块钱赔偿，后脚就上门把我爹给绑了。”“那五十块钱，还是我到处找人借凑齐的。他们家不守信用在先……”“赵小义，你有脸说那五十块？”徐喜弟看范金花缩着脖子不吭声，就知道今天只能自己立起来。“欺负一个残疾人，这是犯罪，想拿五十块钱就把事情盖过去了？欺负我公婆不敢吭声是吧？”“现在张家我做主！钱我昨天已经拿去你家退了，刘宇宁还有李婶都能作证。”“拿点臭钱，就想骑我脖子上拉屎，不可能！谁敢欺负我们张家，我就送他去吃牢饭！”看到徐喜弟叉着腰，所有人都愣了。并不是觉得她凶悍，反而觉得很有味道。主要那张脸本来就好看，凶起来更好看了。赵小义想起自己回家，看到地上的五十块钱，心中了然。原来这钱是徐喜弟给还回去的。可他现在不能认。“你退哪里了，我没看见！”“现在我爹已经被送到县里的公安局了，我又问不着他，谁知道你真退还是假退？”“嘿，你小子！”刘烨说着又要上去提他领口，“不是说了有证人在的吗？少废话，大队长都发话了，自己修还是拿钱赔？！”“关你什么事！”赵小义躲到大队长身后，一边还梗着脖子叫嚣。“你算张家老几，也来管闲事！他们给你什么好处了？钱能分给你呢，还是人给你睡了？”“嘿~你这张臭嘴！”刘烨高高扬起大手。赵小义脖子一缩。连大队长看了都害怕，赶紧开口阻止，“行了，现在打人犯法，你想去见公安？”刘烨这才收回手，他可不能去见公安！小羊山还没开荒完呢！不能打人，但是一些必要的狠话，他还是可以说的。“永福是我从小的好兄弟，谁要敢欺负了他家，先掂量掂量再说。”看热闹的人，又忍不住咂舌，这傻大个天天帮张国海家干活，还帮出感情来了？赵小义看刘烨收了手，又仗着大队长在，胆子大了不少。想让他掏钱赔偿，不可能。想让他来修门，更加不可能。本就是来出气的，砍完又自己修，那他的脸往哪里放？“我家还有那么多农活，我爹不在，只能我自己干，没空修！”大队长嘴角抽了抽，“那就拿钱赔！一院子的东西，还有人家大门都让你砍坏了，拿八十块吧！”“钱也没有……”赵小义打算耍赖了。“没有就去借！”“行啊，那就等我借到了，再送过来吧。”赵小义嘴角一歪，转身扛着柴刀就大摇大摆走了。借？哼，这辈子他都借不到了！“大队长，就这么把他放走？”徐喜弟看就知道大队长想敷衍今天这事。
content_en: When Zhao Xiaoyi heard the sound, the hatchet in his hand paused in mid-air for a few seconds, and finally put it down gently.Forget it, today he is here to give the Zhang family a showdown, and there is no need to conflict with Liu Ye, a big fool.But today he was a 'famous teacher', so he turned around and said to the crowd of onlookers, "Xu Xidi, this cheap girl, she caused my father to be arrested by the police. The Zhang family must give me an explanation." "Try to curse again? Your father is not doing human affairs, what's wrong with the police arresting him?" Liu Ye put aside the plow and nail hoe on his shoulders and walked into the courtyard with his bare hands.Liu Ye heard people discussing this matter when he came back from work last night.Zhao Ding deserves it."The captain will be here soon. If you want to explain to him, you have insulted his daughter, not to mention your father. If I know that you are also involved, I will send you to the police!" "That is, if you meet a scholar like Liu Yuning, I will give him all three legs!" Seeing Liu Ye approaching, Zhao Xiaoyi did not dare to stay in the courtyard, pretending to be calm, walked down, and stood in front of the crowd.Liu Ye is such a big guy, one fist can knock his head into his stomach!"Don't accuse me wrongly, I...I didn't..." Zhao Xiaoyi was obviously stuttering when he spoke.Tsk tsk tsk!Some people in the crowd smacked their tongues in a low voice.Isn't this obviously a thief with a guilty conscience?Zhao Ding and his son are really not human beings!brute!After clicking their tongues, they looked at the Zhang family with a little more contempt.They've all been bullied like this. Now they're sitting there with the door closed, but no one else would have had to rush out and fight.Being beaten to death and crippled is not scary or looked down upon, but riding on someone's neck and shitting is definitely not okay.What's the saying?A scholar cannot be killed but cannot be humiliated... It seems that yesterday he still looked up to Xu Xidi's little daughter-in-law. How can a coward in this family stand up with just one woman?"Zhao Xiaoyi, you don't really have a share, do you?" Liu Ye narrowed his eyes, rushed over in a few steps, and lifted Zhao Xiaoyi's collar."You, you, you, do you have evidence?" Zhao Xiaoyi didn't expect Liu Ye to take action as soon as he said it, and he panicked for a moment."Hmph, if I had evidence, your dog's mouth would be on the ground right now." Liu Ye let go of his hand.There is no other way, I just know that this person is harboring evil intentions, but there is no evidence, so it is illegal to hit someone now."Zhao Xiaoyi, you did all this?" The captain came late and frowned when he saw the mess in the courtyard.Hearing the voices of Liu Ye and the captain outside, the door of the Zhang family finally opened.Fan Jinhua and Xu Xidi came out of the hall, and Sister Ba'er had already eaten her fourth baked glutinous rice cake.This time I was not careful. Halfway through baking, the bulging glutinous rice cakes were ignited by the flames and became completely charred.Eat with a mouthful full of black food.At first glance, he looks heartless."Captain, look, our yard, fences, and vegetable plots were all chopped down by Zhao Xiaoyi. What should we do about this?" Fan Jinhua looked at the messy vegetable plots all over the yard with distress, and not even a single garlic sprout was left in the backyard.The captain also had a headache and pointed at Zhao Xiaoyi, "Now is a new society, you can't do whatever you want. If you cut people's yards like this, will you repair it yourself, or pay for compensation?" "Also, what your father did is illegal and criminal, and it is not allowed by nature. Even jail is a light sentence. In the old society, you were shot! What you did today..." is also illegal and criminal.But the captain didn't want to make a big fuss, he just wanted to keep things quiet.But Xu Xidi disagreed, "Zhao Xiaoyi came to the door with a knife today, which is also a crime. If you want to repair or compensate, you can wait until you see the police!" Send him to the police again?The crowd took a breath of air-conditioning. Are they going to send both the Zhao family and his son to jail?"Meet the police?" Zhao Xiaoyi became angry when he heard Xu Xidi's words."Captain, please judge! Their family asked my father for fifty yuan in compensation, and then he came and tied up my father." "I borrowed the fifty yuan from people everywhere. Their family broke their promise first..." "Zhao Xiaoyi, do you have the nerve to say that fifty yuan?" Seeing Fan Jinhua shrinking her neck and saying nothing, Xu Xidi knew that he had to stand up by himself today."It's a crime to bully a disabled person. You want to cover it up with fifty yuan? You can't say anything when you bully my parents-in-law, right?" "I'm in charge of the Zhang family now! I took the money back to your house yesterday, and Liu Yuning and Aunt Li can both testify." "You want to take some dirty money and just sit on my neck and shit, it's impossible! Whoever dares to bully our Zhang family, I will send him to jail!" Seeing Xu Xidi with his arms crossed, everyone was stunned.It's not that I think she's fierce, but I think she's very flavorful.The main thing is that the face is good-looking to begin with, and it looks even better when it looks fierce.Zhao Xiaoyi remembered that when he went home and saw the fifty yuan on the ground, he understood.It turned out that Xu Xidi returned the money.But he can't admit it now."Where did you retreat? I didn't see it!" "Now my dad has been sent to the county public security bureau, and I can't ask him. Who knows whether you really returned it or not?" "Hey, you kid!" Liu Ye said and went up to pick up his collar again, "Didn't I say there were witnesses? Stop talking nonsense, the captain has spoken, do you repair it yourself or pay for compensation?!" "None of your business!" Zhao Xiaoyi hid behind the captain, holding his neck and shouting."You are the oldest member of the Zhang family, and you are here to meddle in other people's business! What benefits did they give you? Will they give you the money, or will someone sleep with you?" "Hey~ you have such a bad mouth!" Liu Ye raised his big hand high.Zhao Xiaoyi shrank his neck.Even the captain was scared when he saw it, and quickly stopped him, "Okay, it's illegal to hit someone now. Do you want to go to the police?" Liu Ye then took back his hand. He couldn't go to the police!The reclamation of Xiaoyangshan has not been completed yet!He can't hit people, but he can still say some necessary harsh words."Yongfu has been my good brother since childhood. Anyone who dares to bully his family should think carefully before making any decision." People watching the excitement couldn't help but smack their lips. This stupid guy helps Zhang Guohai's family every day, and he also helps out with relationships?Zhao Xiaoyi saw Liu Ye retract his hand, and now that the captain was there, he became a lot more courageous.It's impossible to get him to pay for compensation.It is even more impossible to get him to repair the door.He was just here to vent his anger, but after cutting it off he repaired it himself, so where would he put his face?"My family still has so much farm work. My father is not here, so I have to do it myself. I don't have time to repair it!" The captain's mouth twitched, "Then pay for it with money! You chopped down the things in the yard and the door of the house, so you can take 80 yuan!" "I don't have any money..." Zhao Xiaoyi planned to cheat."If you don't have it, borrow it!" "Okay, then wait until I borrow it and then send it over." Zhao Xiaoyi curled his lips, turned around and walked away with the hatchet on his shoulder.borrow?Humph, he will never be able to borrow it in this life!"Captain, are you going to let him go just like that?" Xu Xidi could tell at a glance that the captain wanted to deal with today's matter.
